messages:
maya (eng-platform): FYI we're getting a burst of strict validation rejects for toolhooks. Many are falling back to degen and being billed there. Can we investigate?

lina (observability): I see `validation.reject` spikes. Most events lack `route_id` so billing attributes to default.

maya (eng-platform): example bad shape: `['ok', {'msg':'pong'}]` vs expected `{\"status\":\"ok\",\"payload\":{...}}`.

noah (eng-runtime): legacy adapters emit tuple-style responses. Parser currently rejects non-object top-level. We can add a coercion step to normalize common tuple patterns to canonical object.

chloe (product): Risks: masking bugs, wrong billing, console noise. We need a canaryed toleration and console visibility.

maya (eng-platform): proposal: add `validation.mode` per-route with values `strict|tolerate|off`. In `tolerate`, runtime coerces tuple->object and emits `coercion_applied=true` plus `original_route_id`.

lina (observability): ingestion currently drops unknown attrs for billing. I will add mapping to copy `original_route_id` through to billing so tokens are charged to the right route. Also create metric `validation.coercion.count{route_id, reason}`.

noah (eng-runtime): implementation details: validator runs after routing; we'll persist `ctx.route_id` and ensure coerced responses keep it. Add sampling (0.5%) of original/coerced examples to S3 with redaction.

maya (eng-platform): add an automatic rollback: if `validation.coercion.count[5m] > 150` AND `degen_billing_delta > 8%` then disable `tolerate`.

chloe (product): Console: add "Validation coercions" panel per-route with counts and downloadable redacted samples. Customers can opt their route out of `tolerate`.

ci-bot: CI: feature/validation-tolerate branch tests passed.

lina (observability): I'll open PR for billing mapping and dashboard tile today.

noah (eng-runtime): I'll implement coercion behind `validation.tolerate_flag` and strong logging for coerced cases.

maya (eng-platform): timeline: 24h for canary in prod 1% slice, 72h for console tile, 2 weeks for adapter lint and deprecation notices.

lina (observability): follow-ups: metric + sample pipeline + billing preserve mapping.

maya (eng-platform): thanks team. Paste any other shape examples here (string-only, number) so we can decide class-by-class handling. :thumbsup:
